# E0731: a closed list in a schema has elements with no one Cap'n Proto type

A closed list whose elements differ in type is a tuple, and Cap'n Proto lists
are homogeneous: the compiler has no one type to give the elements. Cap'n
Proto has no tuple; a struct with a field per position compiles.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				position: [string, int8]
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0731]: position in schema 0.0 is a closed list whose elements have no one Cap'n Proto type
 --> lineage.cue:6:5
  |
6 |                 position: [string, int8]
  |                 ^^^^^^^^
  |
  = note: position in schema 0.0 is the closed list [string, int8], whose elements do not all map to one type; capnp lists are homogeneous (Cap'n Proto rule unknown-list-heterogeneous)
  = help: use a struct: Cap'n Proto has no tuple
```
